component.name: Package Uninstaller
软件包卸载器
component.summary: Cross-distro GUI to browse and uninstall system packages
跨发行版的系统软件包浏览与卸载图形工具

description.p: PkgPurge lists every package installed through the system package manager (APT, DNF, Zypper, Pacman, APK), lets you multi-select packages, previews the full dependency cascade before anything is removed, and executes the removal through pkexec with a strict command whitelist.
PkgPurge 列出系统包管理器（APT、DNF、Zypper、Pacman、APK）安装的全部软件包， 支持多选卸载；执行前先用模拟预览展示完整的依赖级联， 实际卸载通过 pkexec 提权，且提权助手只放行白名单内的包管理命令。
First release: APT/DNF/Zypper/Pacman/APK backends, GTK4 GUI, CLI, deb packaging.
